home_p_19: High-quality fabrics with dense weaving, exceptionally soft to the touch and durable over time. For peaceful and comfortable sleep in every season.
home_p_20: Soft and absorbent towels made from quality cotton, suitable for families and babies. A feeling of comfort and care with every use.
home_p_21: Ready-made gift packages carefully designed – perfect combinations of bedding and towels for every special occasion.
home_p_22: Every product of ours begins with careful selection of quality raw materials. We choose natural fibers, monitor the weaving process, and handle finishing with precision to ensure every touch is soft, pleasant, and inviting.
home_p_23: We use only quality natural fibers – long-staple cotton, organic bamboo, and European linen. 100% natural fibers ensure breathability, durability, and a luxurious feeling on the skin.
home_p_24: Every product is woven using advanced sateen or percale techniques, with high density that ensures exceptional softness. 300+ thread count creates a smooth, silky, and long-lasting surface.
home_p_25: Our products undergo rigorous testing and are treated with anti-static and anti-wrinkle finishes. Tested through 50+ wash cycles to ensure softness and color remain intact for years.
home_p_26: Our customers return to us again and again – because of the comfort, softness, and feeling of a real home that Wrapped in Love bedding provides.

about_h2_1: Wrapped in Love – Quality You Feel in Every Touch
about_h2_4: Ask Us Everything About Feel, Sizes and Care
about_p_12: Our store was born from the belief that every moment at home – from sleeping to bathing – deserves an experience of true comfort. We believe that quality bedding and towels are not just functional items, but a daily ritual of self-care and the feeling of home.
about_p_13: What makes our collection unique is an approach that starts with texture: we choose each product based on touch sensation, lasting softness, and weaving that remains beautiful even after many washes. Here you won't find passing trends – only textiles designed to age beautifully and remain part of your home for a long time.
about_p_14: We believe that every item in the home should provide long-term comfort and build trust with the customer. Our values are rooted in every layer of fabric, every stitch and every service we provide.
about_p_15: We select only high-quality, natural and breathable fabrics that meet the highest standards. Every material is tested for durability, softness and long-lasting color quality.
about_p_16: Every product undergoes a meticulous finishing process, from initial weaving to final stitching. We emphasize small details that ensure a refined appearance and pleasant feel.
about_p_17: Our products are designed to be easy to maintain while preserving quality. We provide clear guidelines for washing and storage so that bedding and towels maintain their softness over time.
about_p_18: We're here to help you find the perfect product for your home. Our team provides personal consultation, quick answers and complete support after purchase.
about_p_19: We believe that choosing bedding and towels isn't just a matter of design – it's about feeling, comfort, and how you want to feel at home. Every customer receives personal and professional guidance, so you'll find exactly what suits you.
about_p_20: First step: Understanding needs. We start with a conversation – what are you looking for? What feeling do you love? Are you sensitive to certain materials? Is it for the bedroom, for children, or perhaps a gift for someone beloved? Every detail matters to us.
about_p_21: A personal and attentive conversation that begins the journey.
about_p_22: Second step: Matching feel and size. We let you touch, feel the fabrics – Egyptian cotton, breathable linen, soft microfiber. We'll check together the exact measurements for your bed, and ensure everything fits exactly as it should.
about_p_23: A sensory experience that allows you to choose with confidence.
about_p_24: Third step: Care guidance. Every product comes with clear care instructions – how to wash, at what temperature, how to maintain softness and durability over time. We want your bedding and towels to remain perfect for years to come.
about_p_25: Professional knowledge that extends product life.
about_p_26: Fourth step: Ongoing support. Even after purchase, we're here for you. Have a question? Want to upgrade? Need a recommendation for an additional product? We're available – because we believe that good relationships with our customers is part of the experience.
about_p_27: Service that stays with you even after purchase.
about_p_28: We're here to help you find the perfect product – whether it's special softness, choosing the right size or long-term care advice. Every recommendation we make is personal and tailored exactly to your needs.

contact_p_13: Tell us about your needs – bed size, fabric feel, the atmosphere you want to create in the room. We'll be happy to help you find the perfect bedding and towels.
contact_p_18: We respect your privacy. Your details will not be transferred to third parties and we will not send you unsolicited mail.
contact_p_19: Here you'll find answers to the most frequently asked questions our customers ask. If you didn't find what you were looking for, we're here for you.
contact_p_20: The right size depends on your mattress size. Bedding for single bed (90x200 cm), bed and a half (120x200 cm), double bed (160x200 cm) and large double bed (180x200 cm). We recommend measuring the mattress before purchase and ensuring the fitted sheet includes elastic that fits the mattress thickness.
contact_p_21: Regular cotton towels are perfect for daily use, bamboo towels are extra soft with high absorbency, and microfiber towels dry quickly and are suitable for sports and travel. We recommend quality cotton towels for families with children and bamboo towels for a home spa experience.
contact_p_22: Wash in lukewarm water (40 degrees) with gentle detergent, without fabric softener which may reduce absorbency. Dry on low-medium temperature or air dry to maintain softness and quality over time. Light ironing on low-medium temperature improves appearance and adds a luxurious feel.
contact_p_23: Our gift sets typically include a complete bedding set (fitted sheet, duvet and pillowcases), towel set (2 bath towels and 2 hand towels), and designer gift packaging. The set can be customized upon request and additional blankets or pillows can be added. It's a perfect gift for young couples, weddings and celebrations.
contact_p_24: We listen to your needs – number of family members, preferences for softness or absorbency, design style, and budget. After a brief conversation, we recommend the most suitable products from our range of bedding and towels. Our goal is for you to feel wrapped in love and maximum comfort at home.
contact_p_25: Our team is here to guide you in choosing bedding and towels that perfectly suit your needs. Send us a message and we'll get back to you soon.

collections_p_16: Each collection is carefully selected to provide you with a unique experience of comfort and quality. Choose according to your mood, room, or special occasion.

collections_p_24: Simple guidelines that will extend the life of your products and maintain the perfect feel you love.
collections_p_25: Wash in lukewarm water up to 40 degrees with gentle detergent. Avoid bleach or strong fabric softeners – they may damage natural fibers and reduce absorbency.
collections_p_26: Air dry or machine dry on low temperature. Excessive drying may cause slight shrinkage and loss of softness. Remove from dryer while products are still slightly damp.
collections_p_27: Ironing is not necessary for most of our bedding and towels. If you choose to iron, use medium temperature and avoid direct ironing on embroidery or decorative details.
collections_p_28: Store bedding and towels in a dry, ventilated place, away from direct sunlight. Proper folding and storage on open shelves will prevent musty odors and allow fibers to breathe.
collections_p_29: Rotate between different sets to reduce wear. Alternating use extends product life and allows fibers to recover between washes.
collections_p_30: Check products periodically for small tears or loose threads. Immediate repair will prevent further damage and maintain the original appearance and feel over time.
collections_p_31: We'd be happy to help you find the perfect products that will suit your exact needs. Whether you're looking for quality bedding, soft towels, or the perfect gift – we're here for you with personalized recommendations.
collections_p_32: We'll get back to you within 24 hours with professional and personal consultation
